props.gloss_en: in twenty-four places the court ostracizes over the honour of the rabbi, and we learned all of them in our mishna (R' Elazar: where? RYbL: when you look, you will find)
he went out, examined, and found three
[the court ostracizes] one who demeans hand-washing
[the court ostracizes] one who speaks after the bier of Torah scholars
[the court ostracizes] one who is arrogant toward Heaven
Akavya ben Mahalalel: one does not give [the sota water] to a convert or to a freed maidservant
the Sages: one does give [them the water]
the incident of Karkemit, a freed maidservant in Jerusalem, whom Shemaya and Avtalyon made drink
and they ostracized him [Akavya], and he died in his ostracism, and the court stoned his coffin
R' Yehuda: God forbid that Akavya was ostracized, for the Temple court was not locked upon any man in Israel [equal] in wisdom, purity and fear of sin to Akavya ben Mahalalel
rather, whom did they ostracize? Elazar ben Chanoch, who cast doubt on hand-washing
when he died the court sent and placed a large stone on his coffin, to teach you that whoever is ostracized and dies in his ostracism, the court stones his coffin

Shimon ben Shetach to Choni: you ought to be ostracized, and were you not Choni I would decree ostracism on you; but what shall I do, you nag before God and He does your will, like a son who nags his father -- and of you the verse says 'your father and mother will be glad' (Prov 23:25)

Todos of Rome accustomed the Roman [Jews] to eat roasted whole kids on Passover nights; Shimon ben Shetach sent to him: were you not Todos I would decree ostracism on you, for you feed Israel sacrifices outside
an oven cut into rings with sand put between ring and ring -- R' Eliezer declares it pure
and the Sages declare it impure; and this is the oven of Akhnai
what is 'Akhnai' [snake]? it teaches that they surrounded it with halakhot like this snake, and declared it impure
that day they brought all the pure things R' Eliezer had declared pure and burned them before him, and in the end they 'blessed' him
R' Yehoshua ben Levi likens one matter to another
and R' Elazar does not liken one matter to another
